context_files_read.purpose: Harness policy for artifact-first validation and real evidence boundaries.

Missing, skipped, and no-baseline states must preserve status and reason.
1000+ coverage is not real automatic coverage by default.

1000 dry-run coverage must not be recorded as real coverage.

Every metric requires identity, source artifact, SHA256, source pointer, phase/run/scenario, node scope, evidence layer, evidence class, and missing semantics.
Rendered CSV, SVG, HTML, and Markdown reports must only be report_view/view coverage.
L03 must not run P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py.
